training: expanding from 2015; StandardScaler + Ridge(alpha=1.0) refit before each calendar quarter; labels mature strictly before first decision
label: raw Open(t+2) / Close(t) - 1; convert to estimated absolute exit price at decision close
entry: one lot on next session opening proxy with previous close as limit; after slippage and tick rounding, respect daily limits; exit any carried lot before new entry
exit: one opening sell attempt from the following trading session; retry at later opens if blocked, retain book value if unresolved
double: repository Costs.stressed(); hold the normal-cost signal approvals fixed
proportional: normal cost with minimum_commission=0; recompute approvals as an exploratory fee sensitivity
gate: predicted cash proceeds at rounded adverse sale quote minus one-lot debit at the existing cap and both fees is strictly greater than zero; no forecast of dividend receipts
screen: candidate net P&L must exceed both zero and prior-close limit, drawdown <=0.15 and no unresolved position under normal and double costs
evidence: historical exploration; 2023–2024 previously inspected; independent forward observation remains pending
